required_native_capabilities.purpose: Bind every owner task to the repository root and its durable instructions.
Load the root AGENTS.md and owner-scoped repository policy.
Isolate candidate work and provide reviewable delivery evidence.
Provide the exact Sol/xhigh authority lane registered by owner orchestration.
Provide the exact Terra/high implementation lane.
Provide the exact Luna/xhigh independent verification lane.
Create, reuse, monitor, and correct packet-bound subordinate tasks inside the saved project.
Let Sol archive accepted or superseded subordinate tasks after durable finalization.

optional_plugins.use_only_when: The approved workflow needs GitHub issues, pull requests, or repository data beyond local Git and the configured remote.
The project is building with OpenAI products or needs current official OpenAI developer documentation.
The user authorizes a bounded security scan or remediation workflow.
Research intake must read an authorized Zotero library instead of local source files.
The approved task needs interactive website inspection or local browser-based acceptance testing.
An owner approves access to a specific external source such as a document store, messaging system, or project tracker.

optional_research_dependencies.capability: Deterministic native-text extraction by PDF page.
limitations: Encrypted PDFs are not opened by the research organizer.
Pages without extractable text remain explicit in the research map.
No submodule, Git LFS, release-asset, issue, or pull-request acquisition.
Only bounded regular files enter immutable research records.
Source licensing and reuse rights require separate review.
